class scaralang.infrastructure.cli.repl.dispatch.repl_command_dispatcher_factory.ReplCommandDispatcherFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing ReplCommandDispatcher instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Builds ReplCommandDispatcher with injected info provider.
create_default - Builds ReplCommandDispatcher with default info provider.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
